SENATE (ELECTION) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
SENATE (ELECTION)
(SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXXXII OF
2002
An Ordinance,
further to amend the Senate (Election) Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part-I, 19th October, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
19-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Senate (Election)
(Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 11, Act LI of 1975

SENATE (ELECTION) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
SENATE (ELECTION)
(SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXXXII OF
2002
An Ordinance,
further to amend the Senate (Election) Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part-I, 19th October, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
19-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 11,
Act LI of 1975.---In the Senate (Election) Act, 1975 (Act LI of 1975), in
section 11, for subsection (3) the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(3) Every
nomination paper shall be delivered by the candidate in person to the Returning
Officer who shall acknowledge receipt of the nomination paper specifying the
date and time of receipt."
